messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy notice: rollout started for sdk-v11 (canary group A) at 3376543210
kevin: saw increased 5xx from paging service right after the canary bump. customers hitting paged endpoints are seeing stalled streams.
priya: logs show `cursor_encode` failing with `InvalidArgument` on client v11 only. stacktrace points to paging/encode.go:47
marc: tagging for incident. can someone post request examples? are these internal CI calls or customer traffic?
kevin: customers. one internal e2e flake earlier but then production spike around +40s.
cs-erin: quoting customers affected: finance-app-prod, docs-search-saas, chatflow-inc — all on older paging usage patterns.
oncall-1: i'm taking this. shifting pager to oncall-1 for now. pinging runtime and sdk teams. @dana can you look at protocol changes?
dana: on it. initial hypothesis: v11 changed the wire format for cursor tokens (shortened header) which older proxies/clients can't parse.
priya: confirmed — encoder now emits `x-cursor-v=2` header and decoder in fallback path doesn't accept it. fallback path only checks `x-cursor-v=1`.
kevin: customers are seeing partial results then immediate connection close. using streaming; not a full 5xx but `ERR_CURSOR_BAD` on client side.
marc: scope impact: ~12 requests per second across 3 accounts, spread across two regions. not all customers hit it, but some heavy producers impacted.
cs-erin: flagged high priority to CS. preparing outgoing note to finance-app-prod that we have a mitigation in progress.
oncall-1: mitigation plan options:
  1) flip feature flag for sdk-v11 server-side to block v11 wire behavior (kill switch)
  2) pause canary rollout
  3) push a hotfix to server decoder to accept v2 cursors
we should do 1+2 immediately, 3 if we can patch quickly.
kevin: how do we flip the FF? deploy console link: https://console.redwood/release/flags
dana: issuing kill switch now: `ff toggle sdk_v11_wire_format false --env=prod --scope=canaryA`
deploy-bot: Feature flag sdk_v11_wire_format disabled for canaryA by dana at 3376543385
oncall-1: confirming: rollback of wire change should preserve client v10/v11 compatibility; will monitor logs.
priya: logs show a steep drop in cursor errors within 30s of FF toggle.
marc: pausing canary rollout overall while we confirm: `release pause sdk-v11` executed.
deploy-bot: Release sdk-v11 paused by marc at 3376543410
cs-erin: sending customers preliminary note: "We saw degraded behaviour for paged streaming in the early canary of SDK v11. We've paused the rollout and enabled a compatibility flag to mitigate. Working on a permanent fix and will follow up."
kevin: working with runtime to validate decoder patch. I have a branch that adds dual-accept logic — should be quick but need canary verification.
dana: if we patch, can we do a canary-only patch to the decoder and resume with narrower scope?
oncall-1: yes. but we need E2E on the 3 affected accounts before resuming wide rollout.
priya: creating a replay harness: will re-run recorded requests from finance-app-prod against patched decoder in staging; will post results in 10–15m.
marc: recording all relevant logs and timelines for postmortem. creating incident ticket: INC-2026-043
marc: assigning owners: kevin (runtime), priya (repro/test), dana (release gating), cs-erin (customer comms), oncall-1 (incident lead)
cs-erin: customer update sent at 3376543450. request triage sheet link: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-043
kevin: repro harness shows cursor encoding accepted by patched decoder, no stream closes, token roundtrip validated.
priya: integration tests green for patched decoder in canary environment. patch ready to ship.
dana: preparing a tight canary: apply decoder patch to canaryA only, keep sdk_v11_wire_format disabled globally until verified.
marc: go for it. deploy command: `kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/decoder decoder:patch-v11-compat`
deploy-bot: Deploy started for decoder patch to canaryA at 3376543620
deploy-bot: Health checks reporting: 3/3 pods ready, latency stable at baseline.
priya: telemetry shows no ERR_CURSOR_BAD in canaryA since patch.
oncall-1: after 20m of clean canary, we'll re-enable wire flag for a narrow test group and monitor.
kevin: re-enabling for a single non-critical account to smoke test.
deploy-bot: Feature flag sdk_v11_wire_format enabled for test-account-3 by dana at 3376543775
priya: smoke test passed. no errors observed for 15m. preparing rollout resumption plan.
marc: decision: keep global rollout paused, enable v11 wire only for limited tenant groups while we do staged canary expansion. customers already impacted will remain on compatibility path.
cs-erin: follow-up commit: drafted customer note summarizing cause (wire format mismatch introduced in SDK v11), mitigation (feature flag & paused rollout), ETA for permanent fix (2–4 hours for staged verification), and contact channel.
kevin: please escalate if any recurrence. I'll start postmortem skeleton once we fully close the incident.
oncall-1: handing off to night oncall at 3376543830 — @sre-night please monitor the flagged metrics for next 6 hours. closing primary incident channel for active ops, keeping this thread for updates.
sre-night: acknowledged, taking over monitoring. will ping if anything spikes.
cs-erin: adding note to ticket INC-2026-043: customers notified, SOC updated, billing/unusual SLA exposure logged.
marc: incident state: mitigated (feature flag + canary pause + decoder patch canary success). next steps: finish staged rollout, finalize postmortem, customer follow-ups.
